video_title: Walker Kessler Breaks Down Playing For JJ Redick

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on JJ Redick's high basketball IQ and coaching style
quotes.excerpt: JJ is a good, good basketball mind. It's pretty obvious, but just how high IQ he is.
quotes.quote: JJ is a good, good basketball mind. It's pretty obvious, but just how high IQ he is. And I think him being a player and being a big-time player in the past, he gets it. I feel like some coaches, and I obviously have only played for two organizations now, but some coaches, whether it's college or whatever, they try to curve messages. They don't outright say what it means or what it is. JJ is very upfront. He's like, 'Hey, we got to do this. I'm not going to spend all this time yelling at you, but this is what it is. Get your act together, let's move on.'
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler praises JJ Redick for his direct communication style saying he is very upfront and does not waste time yelling at players. He says JJ is a good basketball mind who gets it because he was a big time player.
quotes.team: The Old Man and The Three

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea criticizes JJ Redick for not resting starters in blowouts
quotes.excerpt: when you guys are up by 20, 30 and doesn't take the starters out.

text_blocks.speaker: Flea
text_blocks.text: The one thing about JJ, and he's done it ever since he's been a Laker coach, and it drives me up a wall, is when you guys are up by 20, 30 and doesn't take the starters out. It's one thing, and I was screaming at the TV the other night, and then Luka hurt his ankle and I was just like, 'This motherfucker, take him out!'

text_blocks.speaker: Cam Johnson
text_blocks.text: I know you can't talk shit about JJ, but I wholeheartedly feel this is a coaching seal.

quotes.social_post: Flea calls out JJ Redick for keeping starters in during blowouts saying it drives him up a wall. He says he was screaming at the TV when Luka hurt his ankle and believes it is a coaching failure.
quotes.team: The Old Man and The Three

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the team's struggles closing out fourth quarters
quotes.excerpt: we haven't been doing a great job of closing fourth quarters either.
quotes.quote: It's a balance, because one game this year we took out the starters, Toronto, was it? Toronto, and the other team scored 15 points, and then they put back the starters in at the end of the game because we almost sold the game. And then we haven't been doing a great job of closing fourth quarters either. Even last game, Phoenix, we let them back in the game when we were up 25, 26. So it's not all on JJ, but I understand where you're coming from.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler defends the decision to keep starters in late in games noting the team has struggled to close out fourth quarters and almost blew a lead against Toronto after pulling the starters early.
quotes.team: The Old Man and The Three

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson admits his own distraction affects his game viewing
quotes.excerpt: The minute I turn to the game, y'all start fucking up.

text_blocks.speaker: Cam Johnson
text_blocks.text: I know the real problem with that is actually me. If I'm watching something else and I'm just looking at the score, let's say LSU is on, right? If I'm checking the score on my phone, Lakers going crazy. The minute I turn to the game, y'all start fucking up.

text_blocks.speaker: Flea
text_blocks.text: So you can't watch the game anymore, man. Do you know I do this? I'll purposefully be like, if it's too big of a game, I won't watch because I'm too nervous.

quotes.social_post: Cam Johnson admits he is superstitious about watching games saying he purposefully stops watching the Lakers when they are playing well because he feels like he is a bad luck charm.
quotes.team: The Old Man and The Three

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea on the qualities of a great music producer
quotes.excerpt: a great producer is able to listen to something and give a really good objective viewpoint.
quotes.quote: For me, a great producer is able to listen to something and give a really good objective viewpoint of where it's at or how it could be better without having to inject their ego into it or anything. Just how can this piece of music be the most effective? And Rick is really, really great at that.
quotes.social_post: Flea discusses the qualities of a great music producer noting that Rick Rubin is great at providing an objective viewpoint without injecting his own ego into the music.
quotes.team: The Old Man and The Three
